exposure: number of childbirths after MUS (one vs. more than one)
cohort: 228 women who had undergone mid-urethral sling surgery, 72 of whom had given birth after the surgery
finding: There was no significant difference in long-term urinary incontinence outcomes between women who had given birth after mid-urethral sling surgery and those who had not, regardless of mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery did not affect long-term urinary incontinence outcomes in women who had undergone mid-urethral sling surgery.
